title: Get started
text: Small internal tools shared every function package: verbosity: every exported function verbose = 0/1/2 (silent / summary / details). Messages go ppt_msg(). input checks: as_dt() always returns copy, user objects never modified; check_cols() reports missing columns. per-pig fitting: fit_by_pig() runs function pig. pig fails recorded skipped instead stopping everything. removal log: new_removed() builds removed table returned every analysis step. result object: new_ppt_result() gives every calc_*() function return structure.

title: Get started
text: quality-control thresholds live one object created qc_config(). Three presets available, single parameter can overridden.

title: Get started
text: read_station() reads one many station export files (whole folder) stacks one table. Columns checked station type, transponder IDs always read text leading zeros kept, source_file column records row came .

title: Get started
text: clean_weight() cleans body weight records identified visits three layers: record rules: weights outside weight_range flagged; "rlm": quadratic robust regression bisquare weights (MASS::rlm), records weight rlm_cutoff outliers; "loess": robust LOESS (family = "symmetric"), residuals beyond sd_max robust SDs; "stl": STL decomposition daily median weight (weekly period, robust), residuals beyond sd_max robust SDs. Falls back LOESS pigs fewer 14 days; "sd": quadratic least squares, residuals beyond sd_max SDs; optional rel_dev_max daily_drop_min rules; pig checks: number valid records, test length, missing rate, entry exit weight, optionally curve R². Nothing deleted silently: every record keeps qc_flag, every removed pig listed removed reason.
code: visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0) w <- clean_weight(visits) #>  #> ── Cleaning body weight (rlm) ────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> • Weight records: 31,472 #> • Outside weight range: 0 #> • Outliers: 2,975 #> ! Pigs kept: 28, low confidence: 1, removed: 1 w #>  #> ── <ppt_weight> ── #>  #> Pigs: 30 (keep 28, low confidence 1, removed 1) #> $per_pig: 30 rows x 14 columns #> $daily: 2789 rows x 7 columns #> $removed: 1 row x 4 columns #> $records: 31472 rows x 9 columns #> QC profile: "casey"  # Why pigs were removed w$removed #>    responder location         step                 reason #>       <char>   <char>       <char>                 <char> #> 1:     15964      101 clean_weight test period 2 d < 35 d  # Records flagged as outliers head(w$records[outlier == TRUE]) #>    responder location       date seq_days          entry_time weight   fitted #>       <char>   <char>     <Date>    <int>              <POSc>  <num>    <num> #> 1:     13913      101 2024-02-20        2 2024-02-20 01:05:04   31.0 21.48760 #> 2:     13913      101 2024-02-20        2 2024-02-20 06:52:21   28.5 21.69242 #> 3:     13913      101 2024-02-20        2 2024-02-20 06:53:50   29.5 21.69330 #> 4:     13913      101 2024-02-20        2 2024-02-20 08:46:55   30.0 21.76008 #> 5:     13913      101 2024-02-20        2 2024-02-20 11:28:05   29.5 21.85532 #> 6:     13913      101 2024-02-20        2 2024-02-20 11:32:56   27.5 21.85819 #>    outlier qc_flag #>     <lgcl>  <char> #> 1:    TRUE     rlm #> 2:    TRUE     rlm #> 3:    TRUE     rlm #> 4:    TRUE     rlm #> 5:    TRUE     rlm #> 6:    TRUE     rlm  # Another QC preset w_national <- clean_weight(visits, qc = qc_config("national"), verbose = 0) table(w_national$per_pig$status) #>  #>           keep low_confidence        removed  #>             26              3              1

title: Get started
text: calc_adg() estimates average daily gain (ADG) body weight stage stage_range (default 30-120 kg): growth curve fitted valid weight records pig (curve_model: polynomial, robust LOESS Gompertz; Gompertz falls back quadratic curve converge); times curve reaches lower upper stage weight found, searching max_extrap_days first last record; ADG = weight difference / days two times. Every pig gets adg_type: "observed": stage limits reached inside recorded period; "extrapolated": least one limit needs extrapolation, max_extrap_days; "partial": limit reached even extrapolation. ADG mean slope curve part stage covered; "none": less 7 days stage covered; ADG NA.
code: visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0) w <- clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0) adg <- calc_adg(w) #>  #> ── ADG over 30-120 kg (poly2 curve) ──────────────────────────────────────────── #> • Observed (stage inside the records): 24 #> • Extrapolated: 4 #> • Partial (stage not fully reached): 1 #> • No ADG: 0 #> Warning: 1 pig do not reach the whole stage: ADG is based on part of it (adg_type = #> "partial"). #> ✔ Mean ADG: 1160 g/d (SD 124) head(adg$per_pig[, .(responder, adg_type, start_date, end_date, stage_days, adg)]) #>    responder     adg_type start_date   end_date stage_days       adg #>       <char>       <char>     <Date>     <Date>      <num>     <num> #> 1:     13913     observed 2024-02-29 2024-05-16   76.79974 1171.8790 #> 2:     13918     observed 2024-03-06 2024-05-24   78.90401 1140.6265 #> 3:     13954 extrapolated 2024-02-18 2024-05-26   97.85791  919.7008 #> 4:     13996     observed 2024-02-26 2024-05-08   71.09056 1265.9909 #> 5:     14962     observed 2024-02-25 2024-05-07   72.05496 1249.0465 #> 6:     15006     observed 2024-02-26 2024-05-07   70.83402 1270.5759  # Gompertz curve, with quadratic fallback adg_g <- calc_adg(w, qc = qc_config("casey", curve_model = "gompertz"), verbose = 0) table(adg_g$per_pig$curve_used) #>  #>                gompertz poly2 (gompertz failed)  #>                      28                       1

title: Get started
text: flag_feed_errors() applies 16 error criteria Casey et al. (2005, Table 3) every visit. seven variables computed complete visit sequence feeder, including unidentified visits, sorted entrance time: FIV = feed intake per visit (g), OTV = occupation time (s), FRV = FIV / (OTV / 60) (g/min, computed OTV <= 0); LWD = trough weight entrance following visit - exit visit; FWD = trough weight entrance visit - exit preceding visit (FIRE , NEDAP trough weights); LTD = entrance time following visit - exit time visit; FTD = entrance time visit - exit time preceding visit. thresholds come [qc_config()]. Feed disappearance unidentified visits (-20 g <= FIV <= 2000 g) summed per feeder; Casey et al. discarded pens 90 kg, warning given max_unidentified_feed_kg.
code: visits <- prep_visits(fire, verbose = 0) flagged <- flag_feed_errors(visits, verbose = 2) #>  #> ── Flagging feeder errors (Casey et al. 2005) ────────────────────────────────── #> ℹ Visits with at least one error: 2.62% of 9743 identified visits #> • FRV-lo: 64 (0.66%) #> • LWD-hi: 60 (0.62%) #> • FWD-hi: 60 (0.62%) #> • FIV-lo: 33 (0.34%) #> • FRV-hi: 28 (0.29%) #> • FIV-hi: 21 (0.22%) #> • LWD-lo: 5 (0.05%) #> • FRV-hi-strict: 4 (0.04%) #> • FWD-lo: 4 (0.04%) #> • FRV-0: 1 (0.01%) attr(flagged, "feeders") #>    location n_visits n_unidentified unidentified_feed_kg error_rate #>      <char>    <int>          <int>                <num>      <num> #> 1:      101     6014             30                2.148 0.01788102 #> 2:      102     3780             21                0.621 0.03937217

title: Get started
text: calc_adfi() estimates average daily feed intake (ADFI) body weight stage [calc_adg()], FCR compares like like. Correction (Jiao et al. 2014, Casey et al. 2005): pig day, error-free intake y (sum FIV visits without error) modelled linear mixed model fitted pig-days: y ~ location + BW + ADG + 16 x PTE + 11 x OTD + 4 x FID + (1 | pig) PTE: share day’s visits error type p; OTD: occupation time visits error p (types 1, 2, 6-14); FID: feed intake visits error p (types 4, 5, 15, 16); BW: predicted body weight day [calc_adg()]; ADG pig; location fixed effect one station. corrected intake y - sum(b x error covariates): effects error covariates removed, day without errors keeps recorded intake. Covariates without variation perfectly collinear others dropped fitting. Days every visit error error-free intake imputed. Checks imputation stage days pig: corrected intake 0, outside dfi_range, outside optional dfi_quantile limits set missing; impute_method = "linear" (default): linear interpolation inside recorded period ("iii"), robust LOESS gaps longer long_gap_days, per-pig regression intake body weight outside recorded period ("elrp"); impute_method = "loess": robust LOESS daily intake days, used inside outside recorded period. simulation example data (random gaps, long gaps, late entry, early exit) found curve better others every situation: precision depends mainly many days missing stage ends, pigs flagged [calc_fcr()]. Day states: "org" (error, recorded value), "corr" (corrected), "iii" (interpolated), "elrp" (extrapolated), "missing".
code: visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0) w <- clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0) adg <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0) adfi <- calc_adfi(visits, adg) #>  #> ── Flagging feeder errors (Casey et al. 2005) ────────────────────────────────── #> ℹ Visits with at least one error: 1.58% of 31652 identified visits #>  #> ── ADFI over 30-120 kg ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── title: Get started
text: calc_fcr() combines ADG ADFI, computed body weight stage, feed conversion ratio FCR = ADFI / ADG (kg feed per kg gain) inverse, feed efficiency G:F = ADG / ADFI. pig gets fcr_flag = "ok" "low_confidence", reasons fcr_note: growth curve feed intake extrapolated max_edge_extrap_days (default 15) start end stage, ADG part stage , less min_coverage (default 0.7) stage recorded feed intake, weight data flagged [clean_weight()].

title: Get started
text: One plot per station, one panel per pig. Axes adapt data stage_range, point dropped. Colours come colour-blind safe palette (Okabe-Ito) without extra packages.
code: visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0) w <- clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0) adg <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0) adfi <- calc_adfi(visits, adg, verbose = 0)  g <- plot_adg(adg, weight = w, locations = "101", responders = c("13913", "13918", "13954")) #> ✔ Created 1 growth plot g$plot[[1]] f <- plot_adfi(adfi, responders = c("13913", "13918", "13954")) #> ✔ Created 1 feed intake plot f$plot[[1]] out <- save_plots(g, path = tempdir(), prefix = "loc", suffix = "growth", device = "pdf") #> ✔ Saved 1 of 1 plot to /tmp/RtmpQaayMW file.exists(out$file) #> [1] TRUE unlink(out$file)

title: Process and Analyse Pig Performance Testing Station Data
text: tidypptsda cleans analyses visit records automatic pig feeding stations (NEDAP FIRE): body weight cleaning, average daily gain (ADG), feed intake correction (ADFI) feed conversion ratio (FCR). Feeder errors flagged 16 criteria Casey et al. (2005). Daily feed intake corrected linear mixed model Jiao et al. (2014). ADG ADFI computed body weight stage, every pig gets confidence flag explains values obtained. Nothing removed silently: step returns removed table reason. dependencies: cli, data.table, ggplot2, MASS / nlme ship R.

text: Step step, QC preset setting:
code: library(tidypptsda)  res <- run_pipeline(nedap, qc = qc_config("casey"), verbose = 0) res  head(res$fcr$per_pig[, .(responder, adg, adfi, fcr, fcr_flag)]) #>    responder       adg     adfi      fcr fcr_flag #> 1:     13913 1171.8790 2616.719 2.232926       ok #> 2:     13918 1140.6265 2570.041 2.253183       ok #> 3:     13954  919.7008 2343.422 2.548026       ok #> 4:     13996 1265.9909 2857.824 2.257381       ok #> 5:     14962 1249.0465 2818.537 2.256551       ok #> 6:     15006 1270.5759 3084.452 2.427602       ok qc      <- qc_config("casey", stage_range = c(30, 120)) visits  <- prep_visits(fire, qc = qc)          # or read_station("export/") weight  <- clean_weight(visits, qc) adg     <- calc_adg(weight) adfi    <- calc_adfi(visits, adg) fcr     <- calc_fcr(adg, adfi)  plot_adg(adg, weight = weight) |> save_plots("plots", suffix = "growth")

title: Average daily feed intake — calc_adfi
text: visits Visit table prep_visits(), already flagged flag_feed_errors(). adg Result calc_adg(). qc QC settings; default ones used adg. Used : feeder error thresholds, dfi_correct, dfi_range, dfi_quantile, impute_method, long_gap_days, loess_span. verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) 2 (details).

title: Average daily feed intake — calc_adfi
text: object class ppt_adfi (list): per_pig: adfi (g/d stage), adfi_raw (mean recorded intake recorded stage days), adfi_error_free, n_stage_days, n_observed, n_corrected, n_interpolated, n_extrapolated, n_missing, n_extrap_start / n_extrap_end (consecutive extrapolated days start / end stage), coverage (share stage days recorded corrected value), adg_type; daily: one row per pig day: bw (kg), in_stage, n_visits, n_error_visits, dfi_raw, dfi_error_free, dfi_corrected, dfi (final value, g) state; model: fixed-effect estimates correction model; removed, settings.

title: Quality-control settings — qc_config
text: Build set quality-control (QC) thresholds used whole pipeline. Start preset profile override parameter ....

title: Quality-control settings — qc_config
code: qc_config(profile = c("casey", "national", "legacy"), ...)

title: Quality-control settings — qc_config
text: profile Preset start : "casey" (default): feeder error criteria Casey et al. (2005), robust regression (MASS::rlm) body weight outliers quadratic growth curve. "national": LOESS-based weight cleaning growth curve, minimum curve R², longer test period lower missing rate. "legacy": STL + robust regression + robust SD outlier detection Gompertz growth curve. ... Parameters override, name = value. See Parameters.

title: Quality-control settings — qc_config
text: object class ppt_qc: named list parameters preset name attribute "profile".

title: Quality-control settings — qc_config
text: Station transfer (pigs seen several stations) max_gap_days: maximum gap two stations treat pig transferred. larger gap splits two animals. Default 3. max_overlap_days: maximum time overlap two stations. larger overlap treated transponder misreads. Default 1. max_jump_kg: body weight jump transfer triggers warning. Default 10. Body weight records weight_range: valid body weight single record, kg. weight_outlier: one "rlm", "loess", "stl", "sd". outlier_combine: "" (outlier method) "majority". rlm_cutoff: records robust regression weight outliers. Default 0.5. sd_max: residuals beyond many robust SDs (MAD) outliers. loess_span: smoothing span LOESS. Default 0.75. rel_dev_max: optional, relative deviation curve record outlier (e.g. 0.25). NULL = . daily_drop_min: optional, day whose weight ratio previous day outlier (e.g. 0.90). NULL = . Pig-level checks min_test_days, min_records: minimum test length (days) number valid weight records. max_missing_rate: maximum share days without valid weight. entry_weight_max, exit_weight_min: maximum entry minimum exit body weight, kg. curve_r2_min: optional, pigs whose growth curve R² flagged low confidence (removed). NULL = . Growth ADG stage_range: body weight interval ADG FCR, kg. curve_model: "poly1", "poly2", "poly3", "loess" "gompertz" (falls back "poly2" converge). max_extrap_days: maximum extrapolation curve, days. Feeder errors (Casey et al. 2005, Table 3) fiv_range: FIV-lo / FIV-hi, feed intake per visit, g. fiv0_abs_max: FIV-0, maximum |FIV| 0 s visit, g. duration_max: OTV-hi, maximum occupation time per visit, s. speed_fiv_lo_max: FRV-hi-FIV-lo, maximum feeding rate visits 0 < FIV < 50 g, g/min. speed_strict_max: FRV-hi-strict, maximum feeding rate preceding following visit FIV < -20 g, g/min. speed_range: FRV-lo FRV-hi, g/min. idle_duration_max: FRV-0, maximum occupation time intake, s. trough_diff_range: LWD / FWD, trough weight difference subsequent visits, g. max_unidentified_feed_kg: feed disappearance unidentified visits per feeder warning given. Daily feed intake dfi_range: valid daily feed intake, kg. dfi_quantile: optional, lower upper quantile cut-offs (e.g. c(0.025, 0.99)). NULL = . dfi_correct: "lmm" (Jiao et al. 2014) "none". impute_method: "linear" (linear interpolation, LOESS long gaps, intake ~ body weight regression stage ends) "loess" (robust LOESS days everywhere). long_gap_days: inside gaps longer many days imputed LOESS instead straight line (impute_method = "linear"). Default 7. Confidence flags (used calc_fcr()) max_edge_extrap_days: pig "low_confidence" growth curve feed intake extrapolated many days start end stage. Default 15. min_coverage: minimum share stage days recorded feed intake. Default 0.7.

text: Casey, D. S., Stern, H. S., & Dekkers, J. C. M. (2005). Identification errors factors associated errors data electronic swine feeders. Journal Animal Science, 83, 969-982. text: Complete rewrite analysis functions, dev/flat_tidypptsda.Rmd. read_station() -> prep_visits() -> clean_weight() -> calc_adg() -> flag_feed_errors() / calc_adfi() -> calc_fcr() -> plot_adg(), plot_adfi(), save_plots(); run_pipeline(). quality-control thresholds set qc_config() (presets "casey", "national", "legacy"). old function names still work one version, deprecation warning (see ?tidypptsda-deprecated).

title: tidypptsda 0.2.0
text: Feeder errors follow Casey et al. (2005) Table 3: differences subsequent visits computed per feeder include unidentified visits; FRV-hi-strict / FRV-hi wrong (FRV-hi-strict flagged 12 times often FIRE example). Feed intake correction follows Jiao et al. (2014): mixed model fitted pig-days corrected intake error-free intake minus effects error covariates (: model fitted error days , fitted values used intake). ADG stage weight difference divided days times growth curve reaches stage limits; every pig gets adg_type (observed / extrapolated / partial / none). ADFI computed stage days ADG; FCR = ADFI / ADG (corrected_adg removed). body weight 0 treated missing. FIRE visits crossing midnight get right exit time. Pigs seen several stations kept: transfer, split misread. Entry / exit body weight limits now flag pigs low_confidence instead removing . Robust regression uses bisquare weights (Jiao et al. 2014) instead Huber weights. FCR confidence: pig low_confidence growth curve feed intake extrapolated max_edge_extrap_days (default 15) either end stage, instead whenever extrapolation happens. Feed intake gaps longer long_gap_days (default 7) imputed robust LOESS; impute_method = "cumulative_loess" impute_r2_min removed (R2 cumulative curve 0.9 even constant intake, check anything). Use impute_method = "loess" instead. Nothing removed silently: every result removed table step reason.
